policy: A changed upstream ref requires fresh compatibility qualification before this baseline is advanced. The release owner may advance a ref without re-running qualification only through a decision recorded in that upstream's qualification text, and only when the recorded boundary shows no runtime dependency on the change. An upstream may set "blocking": false when its adapter contract does not depend on that upstream's runtime behaviour; drift is then still reported in the canary summary but no longer stops a release. Upstreams without the field keep the strict behaviour.

upstreams.name: OpenClash
upstreams.qualification: Full isolated provider transaction and rollback were qualified on v0.47.156; v0.48.002 has source-derived firewall evidence, not a full provider transaction qualification.

upstreams.name: PassWall1
upstreams.qualification: CFI supports configuration persistence only; no running-service hot apply is claimed. Baseline advanced 2026-11-23 by release-owner decision from 26.11.11-1 to 26.11.23-1 without a new qualification run: the CFI adapter contract has no runtime dependency on the upstream package version, and the claim boundary stays at configuration persistence. Drift is reported only, never blocking, because no claim here depends on the upstream runtime.

upstreams.name: PassWall2
upstreams.qualification: CFI PassWall2 adapter is unsupported; this canary tracks upstream drift and does not imply support. Baseline advanced 2026-11-23 by release-owner decision from 26.11.11-1 to 26.11.23-1; no support claim is made for this upstream. Drift is reported only, never blocking.

upstreams.name: HomeProxy
upstreams.qualification: UCI persistence/transaction contract only; tested package 26.300.08316~d72e293 is not an apply-hot claim. Drift is reported only, never blocking: homeproxy-transaction.sh never invokes init or reloads the proxy, post-apply probing is skipped for this mode, and CFIP_HOMEPROXY_SUPPORTED_VERSIONS is an exact package allowlist, so an unqualified build fails closed instead of silently misbehaving.

upstreams.name: Mihomo
upstreams.qualification: Live provider PUT was tested on the device's alpha-smart-g2e80ed7 core; the latest tagged core has not been separately qualified.

upstreams.name: sing-box
upstreams.qualification: HomeProxy runtime evidence used sing-box 1.12.25-r1; newer engine tags still require a fresh runtime check before any new engine support is claimed. Drift is reported only, never blocking: CFI never drives this engine directly, and its only consumer path (HomeProxy) is persistence-only and gated by an exact package allowlist.
